'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Siege of Gaza City]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] surround [[Al-Ahli Arab Hospital]] in [[Gaza City]] with tanks. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20231116-israeli-tanks-surround-al-ahli-baptist-hospital-in-gaza-city/ (Middle East Monitor)]
***[[Israeli Police]] kill three gunmen who attacked a [[Israeli checkpoint|checkpoint]] near [[Jerusalem]], injuring six [[Israeli security forces|security forces]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20231116-israel-police-confirm-three-gunmen-killed-in-jerusalem-attack (AFP via RFI)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***[[Hezbollah]] launches eight missiles targeting Israeli towns and IDF sites in [[Shtula]] and [[Hadab Yaron]]. [https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/iran-update-november-16-2023 (UnderstandingWar)] 
***[[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] launches heavy airstrikes on Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon. [https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/iran-update-november-16-2023 (UnderstandingWar)] 
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Arakan Army]] captures the town of [[Pauktaw]], [[Rakhine State]]. The [[Tatmadaw|military]] responds by bombing the town with helicopters and [[warship]]s. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/aa-captures-town-in-rakhine-prompting-bombardment-by-myanmar-military.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
**[[India]] reports that over half of the estimated 5,000 [[Refugees in India|refugees]] who fled heavy fighting in [[Myanmar]]'s [[Chin State]] for [[Northeast India|northeastern India]] are returning home after the military and rebels from the [[Chin National Front]] reach a [[ceasefire]] agreement. [https://apnews.com/article/india-myanmar-rebels-fighting-refugees-a05352c40a8bb97caf9ad78b390f5c2d (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Sudan Liberation Movement/Army|Sudan Liberation Movement]], the [[Justice and Equality Movement]] and other smaller rebel factions declare war on the [[Rapid Support Forces]], having previously remained neutral in the conflict. [https://sudantribune.com/article279446/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[24th Annual Latin Grammy Awards]]
**The general categories are dominated by female winners. [https://www.billboard.com/music/awards/2023-latin-grammy-winners-list-1235473553/ (''Billboard'')]
 
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Lüliang office fire]]
**Twenty-six people are killed and 63 others are injured in a fire at an office building in [[Lüliang]], [[Shanxi]], [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-67435673 (BBC News)]
*Four [[Indonesian Air Force]] personnel are killed when their [[Embraer EMB 314 Super Tucano|military planes]] [[plane crash|crash]] in [[Pasuruan]], [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://asiatoday.id/read/2-indonesian-air-force-super-tucano-planes-crash-during-training (Asia Today)]
*Twenty-three people are injured when a [[Chicago "L"]] commuter [[train crash]]es into [[snow removal]] equipment in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-67446323.amp (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[European Commission]] renews its authorisation of the [[systemic herbicide]] [[glyphosate]] for 10 years, following the failure of the [[European Union member states]] to reach a consensus on the renewal. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20231116-eu-commission-to-prolong-use-of-controversial-herbicide-glyphosate-for-10-years (AFP via France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Sweden–NATO relations]], [[Sweden–Turkey relations]]
***The [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Turkish parliament]]'s foreign affairs commission delays a vote on [[Sweden]]'s [[NATO]] membership bid. [https://www.reuters.com/world/swedens-nato-bid-delayed-turkish-parliament-2023-11-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[Parliament of Kenya]] approves the deployment of [[Kenya Police|its police officers]] to [[Haiti]] as part of a [[United Nations]]-backed multinational security mission to combat the [[gang war in Haiti]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/kenyas-parliament-approves-haiti-police-deployment/articleshow/105261226.cms (AFP via ''TOI'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Russian activist [[Aleksandra Skochilenko]] is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to seven years in prison on [[criminal charge|charges]] related to her [[Anti-war protests in Russia (2022–present)|protest]] of the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/16/russian-artist-aleksandra-skochilenko-protested-against-ukraine-war-jailed (''The Guardian'')] 

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**The [[Guatemala]]n Attorney General's Office requests that the immunity of [[President of Guatemala|President-elect]] [[Bernardo Arévalo]] and [[Vice President of Guatemala|Vice President-elect]] [[Karin Herrera]] be lifted for their alleged participation in the seizure of the facilities of the [[Universidad de San Carlos de Guatemala]]. If the request is successful, Arévalo and Herrera could be arrested. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-11-16/guatemala-prosecutors-seek-to-revoke-president-elect-s-immunity (Bloomberg)]
*[[2023 Malagasy presidential election]]
**Citizens of [[Madagascar]] vote for their [[President of Madagascar|president]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/11/16/polls-open-in-madagascar-presidential-election-hit-by-boycott/ (Africanews)]
*[[2023 Spanish government formation]]
**[[Pedro Sánchez]] is re-elected as [[prime minister of Spain]], forming his [[Third government of Pedro Sánchez|third government]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/16/pedro-sanchez-wins-second-term-spain-pm-catalan-amnesty-deal (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*A [[Norse Atlantic Airways]] [[Boeing 787 Dreamliner|Boeing 787]] lands at [[Troll Airfield]] in [[Antarctica]], making it the first time that this type of aircraft has landed in Antarctica. [https://www.flightradar24.com/blog/787-in-antarctica/ (Flightradar24)]
*Casgevy, a world-first gene therapy that aims to cure [[Sickle cell disease|sickle-cell disease]] and transfusion-dependent [[beta thalassemia]], is approved by the [[UK]]'s [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]], becoming the first drug using [[CRISPR]] to be licensed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-67435266 (BBC)]
